title: Problems Around Polynomials — Conjecture 8
exact_target: Does the number of real roots never exceed the number of corners of the binomially weighted tropical coefficient graph?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2200013 (AMR-021-0013). CC BY 4.0.

Boris Shapiro, Problems Around Polynomials -- The Good, The Bad and The Ugly, Arnold Mathematical Journal 1 (2015), pp.91--104, Conjecture 8 and its complete preceding definitions. Original question and full discussion.
